water_tariff_summary.ref: Annex 7 - NWS&DB Water Tariff: Gazette Extraordinary No. 2398/19 of 21 August 2024 (Notice under Section 84, NWSDB Law No. 2 of 1974); effective 21 August 2024; replaces Gazette 2343/28 of 02 Aug 2023.
water_tariff_summary.unit: 1 unit = 1 m3 (1,000 L); Usage Charge Rs./unit and Monthly Service Charge Rs. are tabulated per monthly-consumption band (No. of units). Bill = water charges + monthly service charge + other charges + applicable taxes (VAT). Whether a band rate applies to all units or only units within the band is not stated in the gazette text.
water_tariff_summary.summary: Domestic (T02): increasing-block usage charge Rs.50-280/m3 with service charge Rs.300-4,500/month; Samurdhi (T01): Rs.5-140/m3, service Rs.100-1,600. Non-domestic tables use a flat usage rate (Govt/industry Rs.110, commercial Rs.150, hospitals Rs.95, schools Rs.55, religious/stand posts/bulk Rs.60, port/shipping Rs.750 per m3) plus a service charge rising with monthly consumption band (Rs.400-130,000). Prompt-payment rebate 1.5% within 14 days; late surcharge 2.5%/month after 30 days.

steps: Obtain rates from Section A tables/graphs; if composite rates not available use Section B unit rates.
Add 27% of the rates obtained if Contractor's markup is not included (unless otherwise stated). If included, add nothing.
Apply Table-2 factors to split each rate into local currency (LC) and foreign currency (FC) components.
Price escalation for implementation beyond 31.12.2025: LC 5% per annum; FC 3% per annum.
Sub Total 1 = sum of all items.
(i) Investigation, feasibility, design, tender docs, tendering, supervision = % of Sub Total 1 per Table 4.
(ii) Road reinstatement & power supply, (iii) land acquisition = provisional sums.
(iv) Allow 5% of Sub Total 1 for improvement of Rural Water Supply & Sanitation and Water Resource Development.
Optional provisional sums: vehicles, quarters, training; (v) Duties & Fiscal Levies if applicable.
Physical contingencies: maximum 10% of (Sub Total 1 + Duties and Fiscal Levies).
Total; TCE valid for one year; state FC conversion rate.
estimate_format.preliminaries: Preliminaries approx. 4% of Sub Total 1 (excl. preliminaries) for projects above LKR 500 million; approx. 5% for projects below LKR 500 million.
